text_block_list.text:
The relax-tactic was fearsome. Gold Ship 
put on a magnificent run! But now, her 
fighting spirit is heading in an entirely 
unexpected direction...!

Just as things were on the verge of 
turning into a full-on farm life— Eishin 
Flash challenged them to a showdown at the 
Arima Kinen.

And if you fight her, she'll even give you 
a new secret scroll— it's a deal worthy of 
a TV shopping channel! Gold Ship has made 
her comeback here and now!
